action:
# Click the Chrome three-dot menu (“Customize and control Google Chrome”) in the top-right toolbar
pyautogui.click(x=1346, y=65, duration=0.5)

# Click the three-dot “Customize and control Google Chrome” menu icon in the top-right toolbar
pyautogui.click(x=1330, y=65, duration=0.2)

# Click the vertical three-dot “Customize and control Google Chrome” menu icon just below the window controls
pyautogui.click(x=1340, y=88, duration=0.2)

# Type chrome://settings/privacy in the focused address bar to open the privacy settings page
pyautogui.typewrite('chrome://settings/privacy')

# Press Enter in the address bar to navigate to chrome://settings/privacy
pyautogui.press('enter')

# Click the “Third-party cookies” row in the Privacy and security section to open cookie settings that include the Do Not Track toggle
pyautogui.click(x=676, y=560, duration=0.5)

# Scroll down the Privacy & security settings page to locate the “Send a ‘Do Not Track’ request…” toggle
pyautogui.scroll(-700, x=950, y=600)

# Click the “Third-party cookies” row (third item in Privacy and security card) to open cookie settings
pyautogui.click(x=650, y=515, duration=0.4)

# Click the “Third-party cookies” row’s right arrow (opens detailed cookies settings with Do Not Track toggle)
pyautogui.click(x=931, y=548, duration=0.4)

# Scroll down the Privacy & security settings page to reveal more options including the “Send a ‘Do Not Track’ request” toggle
pyautogui.scroll(-1200, x=1000, y=700)

# Click the “Third-party cookies” row (third item in Privacy & security card) to open cookies settings containing the Do Not Track toggle
pyautogui.click(x=650, y=595, duration=0.4)

# Click the “Search settings” field near the top (inside Settings page header) to start searching for Do Not Track toggle
pyautogui.click(x=531, y=100, duration=0.4)

# Click the “Search settings” field within the Settings page header (just below the toolbar) to focus it for searching
pyautogui.click(x=515, y=101, duration=0.3)

# Click the in-page “Search settings” field (with magnifying-glass icon) just below the address bar to start searching within Chrome settings
pyautogui.click(x=600, y=125, duration=0.3)

# Click the “Third-party cookies” row (3rd item in Privacy & security list) to open its detailed settings, where the Do Not Track toggle resides
pyautogui.click(x=600, y=560, duration=0.4)
